text:
emma: quick note — onboarding Go sample is retrying on 4xx which caused a token-refresh storm in a demo.
ryan: can you show the snippet?
emma: in sampleapp/go/http_client.go they do `if status >= 400 && status < 500 { retry() }` so 401/403 treated same.
mira: yikes. intended behaviour: 401 -> trigger auth refresh once; 403 -> fatal (missing scope).
ryan: i'll patch the sample to special-case 401 and to call IsAuthError helper. also add README comment explaining why 403 is non-retryable.
ci-bot: CI: sample-app-smoke failed on flaky token tests — http://ci.example.com/5001
qa-bot: filing RW-3502: "Sample app: correct 4xx handling and docs" and adding test matrix (401,403,429). assigned to ryan.
mira: long term we should standardize error shape (code, message, http_status, retry_hint) so apps don't rely on status-only heuristics.
emma: agreed. small onboarding change: show idiomatic snippet: `if IsAuthError(err) { refresh(); retryOnce() } else if IsRetryable(err) { backoffRetry() } else { surface() }`.
ryan: I'll open a small PR today and link it to the docs update. thanks! :thumbsup:
